# `vox-http-client`

**Crate:** `vox-http-client` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Shared reqwest ClientBuilder presets and JSON error envelopes.

## Crate Overview

Shared [`reqwest::Client`] / [`reqwest::ClientBuilder`] presets for Vox outbound HTTP.

**Policy:** see `docs/src/architecture/outbound-http-policy.md` in the repo for when to use this crate, migration order, and exceptions.


## Features

| Feature | Default / Enables |
|---|---|
| `default` | — |
| `middleware` | dep:async-trait, dep:http, dep:reqwest-middleware, dep:reqwest-retry, dep:tracing |

## Public API Surface

### Modules

| Module | Description |
|---|---|
| `envelope` | — |

### Functions

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `client_builder` | Builder with user-agent, connect timeout, and idle pool cap suitable for CLI and services. |
| `client` | Fall-back client when a custom builder chain fails to [`build`](reqwest::ClientBuilder::build). |
| `bearer_auth_header` | Build an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header value. Returns `Err` if the token contains characters invalid in an HTTP header value (control chars, non-ASCII).  SSOT for bearer-token formatting — drift-check flags inline `"Bearer {token}"` strings. |
| `bearer_auth_header_string` | As [`bearer_auth_header`], formatted as a raw `String` (for headers maps keyed by string). |
| `parse_retry_after` | Parse a `Retry-After` response header as delay-seconds.  SSOT for rate-limit backoff extraction. Only the delta-seconds form is supported; the HTTP-date form yields `None` (callers fall back to their own default backoff). |
| `populi_control_plane_client` | Wrap a fully configured [`reqwest::Client`] with Populi middleware (trace + optional transient retries).  When `retry_transient` is true, installs [`RetryTransientMiddleware`] with a small exponential backoff cap (see `reqwest-retry` defaults). Inner client timeouts and TLS remain unchanged. |

### Constants

| Constant | Description |
|---|---|
| `BEARER_PREFIX` | `Authorization: Bearer ` prefix — single literal for both senders and parsers. |
| `CONNECT_TIMEOUT` | Default connect timeout for outbound HTTP (15s — interactive CLI / service). |
| `POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT` | Idle connection pool timeout (90s). |
